newsitem.title: USA: AmEx closes higher after Q1 beats consensus.
newsitem.headline: AmEx closes higher after Q1 beats consensus.

text.p: American Express Co shares closed higher after the company reported first quarter earnings of $0.94 per share that beat the First Call consensus estimate of $0.92 per share.

"TRS (Travel Related Services) was healthy and credit quality was good," said Moshe Orenbuch, analyst at Sanford C. Bernstein Co. He noted that earnings in the Financial Advisors unit "re-accelerated somewhat."

The net income in the Financial Advisors unit rose to $157 million from $130 million a year ago, a gain of 21 percent, while net income in Travel Related Services was $315 million, an increase of 10 percent from the $286 million a year ago.
